prompt: What year was the person born who was Prime Minister of The United Kingdom during the year that the first African American ran for president of the United States?
answer: Barack Obama was the first African American to run for president on a major-party ticket in **2008**. The UK prime minister that year was **Gordon Brown**, who was born in **1951**.
